test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If an article is sold at 9/10th of its usual selling price, 20% profit would be made on it. Find the profit percentage which would have been made on it on selling it at its usual selling price.
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price at 9/10th of usual selling price (Discounted price) = 100% - 20% profit

**Formula used:**

Profit percentage = ((Selling price - Cost price) / Cost price) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the selling price be 100x.

The article is sold at 9/10th of its usual selling price, a 20% profit is made.

The SP will be 90x.

CP × (100 + profit%)/100 = SP'

CP × (100 + 20)/100 = 90x

CP = 90x × (10/12)

CP = 75x

Now the article is sold at actual price, so profit percentage will be

(25x)/75x × 100

1/3 × 100

33.33%

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
